title: Building the ltc Docker Image
text: Docker caches layer (step) Dockerfile. : 1. Build old Dockerfile → Docker caches steps 2. Update Dockerfile → Docker still uses old cached layers 3. Build → Uses old cache, doesn’t see new install2.r command Solution: ---cache forces Docker rebuild everything scratch.
